outline: This course includes two main parts: (1) Introduction of first-order ordinary differential equations, second-order and higher-order linear differential equations, including physics problems or other problems to derive differential equations, and solve them in a practical importance simple method. (2) Linear algebra, matrix, vector, determinant and linear equations can be applied in the optimized calculation process of circuits and mechanics.
schedule:
week 1~3: 介紹一階常微分方程式
week 4~6: 二階與高階的線性微分方程式
week 7, 8: 物理問題或是其他問題導出微分方程式
week 9: 期中考
week 10~12: 微分方程式的級數解
week 13~16: 線性代數，矩陣。
week 17: 期末整合複習
week 18: 期末考
materials:
Advanced Engineering Mathematics
Erwin Kreyszig, Wiley 11th edition.
consultation: 建立班級line 群組。Office hour.
